annotation.title_clean: RBAC-E nº 94, Emenda nº 03 – Requisitos Gerais para aeronaves não tripuladas de uso civil
annotation.title_en: Brazilian Civil Aviation Regulation RBAC-E No. 94, Amendment 03 – General Requirements for Civil Unmanned Aircraft
annotation.authors_or_issuer: ANAC - Agência Nacional de Aviação Civil (Brazil)
annotation.venue: ANAC – Regulamentos Brasileiros da Aviação Civil (RBAC)
annotation.summary_en: Brazil's ANAC special civil aviation regulation (RBAC-E 94, Amendment 03, effective May 2023) governing civil unmanned aircraft: classification by weight, remote pilot requirements, flight rules, registration, design authorization, airworthiness certificates, continued airworthiness and penalties. It prohibits autonomous operation and requires third-party liability insurance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Classifies RPAS into Classes 1–3 by maximum takeoff weight, with escalating design, certification and maintenance requirements.
Prohibits autonomous operation of unmanned aircraft (E94.103(c)); remote pilot must be able to intervene.
Requires third-party damage insurance for non-recreational operations above 250 g.
Requires registration with ANAC, identification marks, and operational risk assessment valid for 12 months.
Remote pilot in command is directly responsible for safe operation; operations restricted to areas distant from third parties (30 m minimum).
